notes: Parses to a plain object; the adapter walks it, reading attributes from the @_ keys and text from #text keys and leaf values. Two options differ from the defaults because the content is not delivered without them: ignoreAttributes: false (attributes are dropped by default) and htmlEntities: true (numeric character references such as © are left undecoded by default). Under the default parseTagValue, text that looks like a number comes back as a number, which the adapter measures through String(); the fixtures have no number that changes when round-tripped. Text is trimmed and the pieces of mixed content are joined, which the non-whitespace text measure tolerates.
